underlyingEvidence.description2: Explores ethical persuasion and climate communication. Students learn persuasive communication models and frameworks and collaborate with climate scientists at the Delta Climate Centre to produce sustainability messaging on water, food and energy.

An individual research paper evaluates selected persuasion tools through literature review, field research diaries and reflective analysis of their use.
